items.en_title: Mogi Mirim (SP) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #7
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Mogi Mirim (SP) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 148.40; proposals close Nov 20, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
